scope_note: Area 2 collaborative drug therapy management: who may practice it and where, the agreement, and prescribing under an agreement. New sections with no prior audit. Declined: MA-EMERGENCY-VACCINE-GATE and MA-EMERGENCY-VACCINE-PROTOCOLS share only the section number 105 CMR 700.003 with a dependency; 700.003(F) is emergency vaccine administration, the subject of the forthcoming public-health section, not CDTM. Known and not repaired before this freeze: MA-CDTM-QUALIFICATIONS links M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2 at a URL that does not resolve; the rule is snapshotted by a RELEASED adjudication (MA-Q-0081), so correcting the link would invalidate that question and it is carried as recorded debt.
